title: CR-PAY-043 — WO + customer + full invoicing (delete)
preconds: Permissions (counted): WO View + Customers V + Invoicing V+E+D. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin + AP/AR. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: See WOs; see customers; process payments; deposits; send to terminal; delete payments (incl customer payments); void transactions; delete a Part Sale return

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1a+§1d+§1h
Flag / Note: \u26a0 Delete force-enables AP/AR (gate #2) + See Financial
